2126162598173237521.en_summary: In interview with @JanetOnTheMoney on @SiriusXM, states if Jensen Huang's affair with Alice Huang was garden variety it would fade fast, but it involved national security. Jensen Huang's China problem isn't going away.
2126162598173237521.zh_summary: 在@JanetOnTheMoney於@SiriusXM的訪問中表示，若黃仁勳與Alice Huang的婚外情只是普通類型就會很快消失，但涉及國家安全。黃仁勳的中國問題不會消失。

2126162059238715618.en_summary: Facts on Nvidia: Singapore subsidiary booked roughly $104 billion in 2025 but functions as billing hub, actual shipments to Singapore under 2% of revenue. By customer HQ: US ~69% of FY2026 ~$216B, Taiwan ~20%, China ~9%. Restrictions apply to advanced chips to specific countries, demand far exceeds supply, expects strong performance.
2126162059238715618.zh_summary: 英偉達事實：新加坡子公司2025年入賬約1040億美元，但主要為開票中心，實際運往新加坡不足總收入2%。按客戶總部：美國約佔2026財年2160億美元的69%，台灣約20%，中國約9%。限制適用於運往特定國家的先進晶片，需求遠超供應，預期表現強勁。

2126159543461929276.en_summary: Notes it looks painful for Buffett to utter praise for Elon. Quoted Buffett on Tesla: EV change important but replacement slow due to 11-12 year average car age, by 2030 surprised if more than third of new cars electric, total fleet maybe 10%. On Musk done remarkable things but would not invest in Tesla. Rates important but not knowable.
2126159543461929276.zh_summary: 指出巴菲特勉強說出對馬斯克的讚美看起來很痛苦。引用巴菲特談特斯拉：電動車變化重要但替換緩慢，平均車齈11-12年，到2030年若超過三分之一新車為電動會驚訝，總車隊可能僅10%。對馬斯克做了了不起的事，但不會投資特斯拉。利率重要但不可知。

2126148756722819305.en_summary: S&P Global put chipmaker Nvidia's AA credit rating on watch for downgrade, citing governance risks after the board rushed CEO Jensen Huang back into his job with Pres. Trump's blessing. The bloom is coming off the AI hype.
2126148756722819305.zh_summary: 標普全球將晶片製造商英偉達的AA信用評級列入下調觀察，理由是董事會在特朗普總統祝福下匆忙讓CEO黃仁勳復職帶來的治理風險。AI炒作的光環正在褪去。

2126144152739991946.en_summary: Asks who discussed the incessant M2 growth at the dinner table, quoting that gold and silver just went vertical.
2126144152739991946.zh_summary: 詢問誰在餐桌上討論過持續的M2增長，引用黃金和白銀剛剛垂直上漲。
